title: chore: restore staging Discord OAuth credentials
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores the existing encrypted Discord OAuth client credentials for staging only.
- Leaves all other decrypted staging secret values unchanged.
- Enables testing the Discord account-linking PR on Enter staging.

gist.headline: The staging hive reconnects
gist.blurb: Discord account linking has its staging pollen again. The secret garden is ready for a careful test flight.
gist.summary: Restored the encrypted Discord OAuth client credentials in Enter staging so the Discord account-linking flow can be tested without changing other staging secrets.
gist.impact: Contributors can now validate Discord account linking on the Enter staging environment before it reaches the public hive.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny staging-test helmet, reconnects a glowing Discord-style chat bubble to a cozy retro terminal in a garden shed. The scene represents restoring a private staging credential and safely testing account linking, with a small lock-and-key motif and code-plants nearby.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic with a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and soft pastel gradient background, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike; pixel-font text on the terminal reads "STAGING LINK".
